name: training-monitor
description: Monitoring doctrine for pretraining runs, distilled from Chunyuan Deng's "Reading a Pretraining Run" (2026): the nine first-screen signals, a 40-row metric table with cadence and priority (P0 every step, P1 every 100 steps, P2 on demand), the formulas, the cross-rank reduction rules, a robust spike detector, the fixed triage order, and the common mistakes. One text skill, no code: the agent maps each signal onto what its stack already logs and decides for itself whether a script is warranted.
